title: The Little Star Who Wanted to Visit Earth
originalStory: A little star peeked out from the night sky and wished to visit Earth. It slid down a moonbeam, made a new friend in a garden, and found its way home with a happy heart.
visualBible: Luna: a small warm-gold five-pointed star with a gentle smiling face, tiny sparkles at the tips, no clothes. The garden: round green hills, a winding stone path, and oversized glowing flowers.

pages.text: High above the quiet town, a little star named Luna peeked out from behind a silver cloud. She had never been closer to Earth than this. Tonight, she wished she could see the flowers that glowed so softly below.
pages.illustrationScene: A small smiling golden star peeks from behind a silver cloud above a quiet town at night, warm storybook lighting.

pages.text: Luna slid down a moonbeam and landed in a garden of tall, friendly flowers. A child watering the path waved and whispered hello. Together they watched the petals shine like tiny lanterns.
pages.illustrationScene: The small golden star stands in a garden of oversized glowing flowers beside a child with a watering can, moonlight on a stone path.

pages.text: When it was time to go, the child pointed to the brightest moonbeam. Luna climbed it slowly, her sparkles trailing like a goodbye. From the sky she winked, promising to visit again tomorrow night.
pages.illustrationScene: The small golden star climbs a glowing moonbeam above the garden while a child waves goodbye, sparkles trailing behind, happy ending.
